items.title: MECH-440 legs (ii)/(iii): state-conditioning + self-annealing second-order falsifier (armed raised-floor stack, ANNEAL vs NO_ANNEAL ablation)
items.note: Routed by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-955_2026-08-29 (confirmed, user-ratified 2026-08-29; ratified again at /governance same day, session governance-20260829-mac), section 7: "Routing: /queue-experiment, NEW EXQ for state-conditioning + self-annealing (per-state noise-magnitude covariance with state; per-parameter sigma trajectory vs policy confidence), on the same armed raised-floor stack. Explicitly NOT a 955a same-question re-run." 955 confirmed MECH-440 leg (i) PROPAGATION only (secondary_checks_measured=false in its own manifest); legs (ii)/(iii) were never measured anywhere in the corpus. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readouts (per-tick A0_OFF-referenced raw_score_range paired with lever-arm divergence, stratified by seed-median; ARM_ANNEAL-vs-ARM_NO_ANNEAL differential divergence suppression by stratum) recorded nowhere in the corpus -- not recoverable by reanalysis -> run. A0_OFF is NOT reused from 955 despite being config-slice-identical and reuse-eligible there: this driver's yoked pass needs a LIVE jointly-stepped A0_OFF agent, which the arm-reuse mechanism cannot supply. Step 2.5b re-derive brake: 0 substrate_ceiling-category autopsies for MECH-440 (955 resolved MEASURES FAILED, an adjudication-branch defect, not substrate_ceiling) -- NOT braked. Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap gate: same two OPEN corrupting substrate_queue entries as 955 (mode-governance-engagement, contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy) carved out per 949/955's identical precedent. DESIGN: 3 arms (A0_OFF / ARM_ANNEAL / ARM_NO_ANNEAL, the anneal-flag-only ablation of 955's ARM_NOISE_SINGLE), same matched armed-conversion stack, class floor raised to action_dim, same P0=100/P1=50 phased training, P2=100 yoked episodes. 955's ARM_TEMP dropped (propagation already confirmed, not re-tested). Seed 44 swapped for 48 (955's autopsy diagnoses 44 as a coupled near-saturation anomaly on this env/floor; avoided for a first measurement of the new per-tick stratification instrument). FIXES 955's own driver-fix note: the ceiling-headroom precondition now MEAN-aggregates (not max) across seeds. TWO LOAD-BEARING CRITERIA: C_STATE (leg ii, operationalized as impact concentration -- ARM_ANNEAL's divergence from A0_OFF concentrates in near-tie (low raw_score_range) states, not raw bias-magnitude covariance, which is close to tautological given the noise head's linear dependence on candidate features within a fixed-eps tick); C_ANNEAL (leg iii, causal ablation -- ARM_ANNEAL suppresses divergence in DECISIVE states relative to ARM_NO_ANNEAL while near-tie-state rates stay comparable, i.e. selective not uniform decay). PASS requires BOTH on >=2/3 of >=4 eligible seeds; one-of-two reads as mixed, naming which leg confirmed. VACUITY RULE unchanged from 955/949. SMOKE: --dry-run PASS on ree-cloud-1 (this box lacks torch; ree-v3 CLAUDE.md "Running the test suite" routing applied by proxy for a single smoke run over ssh). validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings after adding MIN_STATE_PAIRS to the config_slice). INSTRUMENT CONTROL self-yoke divergence = 0.000000 for all 3 arms. state_stratification instrumentation confirmed live (33 genuine (raw_score_range, diverged) pairs collected on a 3-episode/25-step dry-run, exceeding MIN_STATE_PAIRS=30 threshold behavior at the intended scale). estimated_minutes calibrated from 955's own measured elapsed (13.1h on ree-worker-1, same arm count/seed count/P0/P1/P2 budget), +modest margin for the added per-tick bookkeeping.

items.title: MECH-320 tonic-vigor selection-authority retest on ready scaffolded_sd054_onboarding (3-arm: baseline/additive/multiplicative)
items.note: MECH-320 tonic-vigor selection-authority retest. PREMISE CORRECTION: the originating chip (chip-20260827-queueexp-mech320-authority-retest) asked to re-run the 3-arm discriminative pair with use_modulatory_selection_authority=True on the premise that the authority substrate had never been exercised for MECH-320. That premise is FALSE: V3-EXQ-624c's manifest records config.use_modulatory_selection_authority=True in all arms (verified 2026-08-29). A bare re-queue would repeat 624c. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (skill Step 2.5b): FIRES at 4 counted substrate_ceiling/non_contributory hits for MECH-320 (failure_autopsy_604a-624a-630_2026-06-03, failure_autopsy_EXQ-572-573_2026-05-17, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-624b_2026-06-07, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-603g-624c-651a_2026-06-07) >= threshold 2. BRAKE RELEASED: the most recent counted autopsy (624c) named target_sd_id='scaffolded_sd054_onboarding' as the sole residual gate (user adjudication: block on foraging competence, do not re-queue a regime tweak); that substrate flipped ready=true 2026-06-11 (V3-EXQ-603n PASS) and no MECH-320 retest has used it. This entry is that retest, on the now-ready curriculum, not a regime tweak. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = P2 action_density lift of vigor-ON vs vigor-OFF on a foraging-competent policy. No recorded manifest carries it -- the last MECH-320-tagged manifest is 624c (2026-06-07), which predates the ready substrate and measured on an ad-hoc regime whose positive control held only 2/5 seeds. Not recoverable -> run. SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP GATE (Step 2.5c): three open corrupting entries (mode-governance-engagement, SD-082, contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy) list bare ree_core/agent.py, which every driver imports; their actual defect paths sit behind default-OFF knobs this script never enables (use_lateral_pfc_analog=False, sd016_writepath_mode='off', use_external_task_drive=False) -- nominal overlap only, not exercised. KNOWN LIMITATION (degrading, non-blocking): open entry 'mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism' (severity degrading, status validated_negative / implemented_pending_validation) lists experiments/scaffolded_sd054_onboarding.py and ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py, both of which this run does exercise; this run happens under that known limitation. DV-SYMMETRY (Step 3.5, per arm; DV = P2 action_density, derived from committed argmax selections): ARM_0 applies no manipulation (reference). ARM_1's additive bias is class-differential (-w_action*v_t on the four movement classes, +w_passive*v_t on noop_class=4), NOT a uniform broadcast scalar, so it is not invariant under argmax. ARM_2's multiplicative form scales that same class-differential bias by |score_i|, which is neither a uniform additive constant nor a single monotone rescale of all candidates, so it too is not invariant under argmax. Script authored + smoke-PASSed 2026-08-28 (ree-v3 18629e9) but its queue entry was never committed (git log -S on experiment_queue.json finds no V3-EXQ-951) -- a stranded append; this entry lands it. Re-smoked locally 2026-08-29 (dry-run end-to-end clean, no manifest written). ARC-068 Niv-vs-Salamone dissociation is explicitly OUT of scope here.

items.title: SD-e1-item1 action-conditioning validation: ON-vs-OFF per-action divergence, C3/cr_ratio non-gating (queue-refill chip chip-20260829-sd-e1-item1-validation-exq-b)
items.note: Validates SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training ITEM 1 (ree-v3 26557a3758, 2026-08-29; design doc REE_assembly/docs/architecture/sd_e1_rollout_consistency_training.md, commit REE_assembly 1f8870d290): E1's forward transition is now action-conditioned via a dedicated LSTM input channel (E1Config.action_conditioned_transition / action_cond_unzero_self_slot), replacing the single-projection path V3-EXQ-954 (2026-08-29, PASS, confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-954_2026-08-29) showed floors per-action divergence at h=1 with the horizon-compounding signature absent (cr_ratio 4.76e-07/5.39e-07 vs a 0.1 bar; red-team attribution: ~5,000x per-action attenuation inside E1, prior_generator ~7x, LSTM+output_proj ~675x dominant, still untouched by this build). SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT INSTRUCTION (per the originating chip): this is NOT a retest of C3_VAR_THRESHOLD / cr_ratio -- those are ITEM 2's target (the multi-step/rollout-consistency training objective, still pending_implementation). ITEM 1 is an interface-only fix; cr_ratio(h)/e1coe_score_var are recorded per the existing V3-EXQ-954 methodology (unchanged Phases 1-4/4b) as ITEM 2's future baseline but are explicitly non-gating -- see interpretation.non_gating_reference in the manifest. ITEM 1's own load-bearing criterion (Phase 4c, redesigned from 954): a direct-channel one-step per-action divergence probe holding (z_self_0, z_world_0) bitwise fixed across all K actions and varying only the actions= one-hot passed to agent.e1(...) -- the isolated test of ITEM 1's own dedicated channel, independent of any E2-mediated indirect route (954's Phase 4c routed actions through E2 first, which predates ITEM 1 and cannot isolate it). DESIGN: 3 arms (A_off action_conditioned_transition=False / B_action True+unzero=False / C_both True+unzero=True) x seeds [42,123] (matches 954's seeds so A_off is checkable against 954's own recorded numbers via readiness precondition P_OFF_ARM_REPRODUCES_954). Acceptance: per-cell (arm in {B_action,C_both}, seed) relative_lift = ratio_action_vs_real_h1[ON]/ratio_action_vs_real_h1[OFF] >= LIFT_FACTOR, where LIFT_FACTOR = max(3.0, 2.0*measured_off_arm_cross_seed_noise_ratio) is DERIVED from this run's own OFF-arm measurement (never an inherited historical constant, per the V3-EXQ-936a both-tails-need-floors lesson), PLUS an absolute floor (ON arm's raw action_cr >= 1e-7) AND an absolute-lift-multiple guard (ON action_cr >= 2x the matched OFF action_cr) so a 'lift' cannot be manufactured from an OFF arm sitting at numerical noise. Label PASSes (action_conditioning_converts_both_arms / _one_arm) when >=1 arm clears all three on every seed. Five P0 readiness preconditions (encoder_trained, real_zworld_nondegenerate_h1, no_missing_action_calls [vacuity trap 1: E1DeepPredictor._action_cond_missing_calls==0 -- every actions= call this script makes on an action-conditioned E1 supplies a real, freshly-constructed one-hot, verified non-None+exactly-one-hot at each call site, so this trap cannot fire by construction], direct_action_supply_fraction>=0.999 [this script's own buffer-free analogue of vacuity trap 2/3, since it -- like 954 before it -- never calls REEAgent._e1_tick() and so never populates the internal _action_experience_buffer; agent.e1_action_buffer_stats() is recorded for cross-reference ONLY and is EXPECTED to read nonzero_fraction=0.0, documented explicitly in the module docstring so this is not mistaken for a defect], off_arm_reproduces_954 [A_off's ratio_action_vs_real_h1 at h=1 < 1e-3 on every seed]) all self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue on failure, never a false PASS/FAIL verdict. agent.record_executed_action() is called after every REAL env-executed action (Phase 0b training, Phase 1 goal template, Phase 2 warmup state, Phase 4b real-state sampling) in every arm per the chip's explicit instruction and for _last_action hygiene across other REEAgent subsystems -- but is deliberately NOT the source of any actions= tensor this script passes to agent.e1() (those are always freshly-constructed local one-hots), and is deliberately NOT called in Phase 4/4c (imagined/synthetic candidate evaluation, not real execution -- calling it there would conflate imagination with reality per MECH-094-adjacent hygiene). Uses experiments/_lib/zworld_p0_warmup.run_zworld_p0 (SD-070 sanctioned encoder warmup, RNG-neutral) + arm_fingerprint.arm_cell() per (arm,seed) cell (config_slice_declared=True) + write_flat_manifest/stamp_recording_core (standard recording core) + experiment_protocol.emit_outcome (runner-conformance sentinel). EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE=diagnostic, claim_ids=[] (this validates the ITEM 1 substrate build itself, deliberately separate from the governance-routed MECH-135/INV-088 pending_retest_after_substrate claims retest that ITEM 1 unblocks -- per the chip's explicit framing, tagging those claims here would be speculative per REE_Working/CLAUDE.md's claim_ids accuracy rule). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): the decisive readout (per-action one-hot-conditioned E1 one-step divergence on a TRAINED, action-conditioned E1, isolated via a direct actions= channel) does not exist in any prior manifest -- 954's own manifest predates ITEM 1's build by construction (it is the failure record ITEM 1 was built to address) and its one-step probe routes actions through E2, never through E1's own actions= channel -> not recoverable, proceed to author. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): not applicable -- validates a substrate that did not exist until ree-v3 26557a3758 (2026-08-29); no prior autopsy exists to brake against at this granularity. SMOKE (--dry-run, 2026-08-30, seed 42 only, reduced scale n_train=2/zworld_p0=3/steps_ep=50/n_sequences=5/horizon=10/n_real=15): all 3 arms PASS their internal readiness; A_off K=5 pairwise_dist mean/min/max EXACTLY 0.0 (bitwise action-blindness reproduced by construction, as documented -- z_self_0/z_world_0 identical across all K actions when the action channel is inert), ratio_vs_CR_real(h=1)=2.07e-07 (well below the 1e-3 off-arm-reproduces-954 ceiling); B_action/C_both both show genuine nonzero per-action divergence (pairwise_dist mean ~3.5-4.1e-04, ratio ~4.0-4.6e-03), clearing the derived LIFT_FACTOR=3.0 (measured OFF-arm cross-seed noise ratio 1.0 at this reduced single-seed smoke scale, so LIFT_FACTOR floors at its 3.0 absolute minimum) by roughly 4 orders of magnitude on the ratio statistic; label=action_conditioning_converts_both_arms, status=PASS, non_degenerate=True, vacuity checks clean (missing_action_calls=0, direct_action_supply_fraction=1.0 on all arms). Queue was starved (floor 3, actual 2 before this add) -- this is an explicitly wanted refill per the originating chip.

items.title: SD-017/ARC-045/MECH-166 slot-differentiation ceiling retest: BIAS write-selection (contextmemory_write_usage_balancing) supersedes 436f SD-016 arming
items.note: Executes the 2026-08-30 A.6 due-ness assessment (chip-20260830-sd017-ceiling-retest, ratified decision) -- this is not a re-derivation, it is the queued follow-on. RE-DERIVE BRAKE RELEASED: SD-017 hit its 3rd substrate_ceiling autopsy at V3-EXQ-436f (2026-08-16), which explicitly REFUSED a same-question 436g re-queue until the write-path build landed. That build (substrate_queue.json:contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy, ready: true, status implemented_pending_validation) landed 2026-08-19; V3-EXQ-943 (2026-08-19) independently validated the BIAS occupancy floor at 16/16 occupied slots on 5/5 seeds (round-robin agreement 0.993-0.996, entropy ~4.0, self_repeat 0), vs LEGACY argmin's still-2/5 (matching 436e/436f's own measurement). That is the Step-2.5b release condition -- proceeding. Uses BIAS write-selection (contextmemory_write_usage_balancing=True) rather than 436f's SD-016 read-path production combination: 436f already demonstrated the SD-016 combination (cue_slot_tagger + gumbel + context_divergence_weight=0.5, confirmed ENGAGED via sd016_arming_engaged) does not move write-path slot occupancy by even one seed (2/5 in both 436e and 436f, same seeds 7/13/100 locked at 1 slot in BOTH arms) -- the defect is structurally on the WRITE side (ContextMemory.write()'s hard scores.mean(0).argmin() under a near-constant query stream) and no READ-path fix reaches it. BIAS resolves the write-path defect directly. Deliberately does NOT compute or gate on the 2-cluster occupied-slot-set Jaccard content-discrimination criterion from the V3-EXQ-956 lineage -- the 2026-08-29 scoping spike (evidence/planning/contextmemory_write_c2_criterion_reposed_20260829.md) diagnosed that instrument as mis-posed (near-binary, aliasing-prone at n=5 seeds; two independent loss designs both failed it with the identical bimodal mean-0.400 signature already seen on 2026-08-19 for an unrelated mechanism) and explicitly recommended proceeding on the occupancy floor already met rather than gating this retest on that criterion; the occupied-slots-only cosine DV inherited from 436e is itself a graded, non-aliasing content-discrimination readout, so nothing additional was needed. Step-2.5c substrate-path-overlap check: the one open 'corrupting' substrate defect overlapping this experiment's modules (contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy, touching ContextMemory.write / compute_write_addressing_loss / agent.py::compute_prediction_loss) is not routed around here -- it IS the exact substrate this experiment exercises the fix for, and its corrupting behaviour manifests only on the default argmin path, which this script avoids via BIAS. Adds a NEW C1 effect-size margin on top of 436e/436f's bare per-seed sign-count test (no bare sign tests per this week's design constraint): requires mean signed delta over scoreable seeds <= -max(EFFECT_SIZE_ABS_FLOOR=0.02, EFFECT_SIZE_SD_MULT=1.0 * pooled_delta_sd, NULL_SD_MULT=2.0 * untouched_bank_null_sd), i.e. floored jointly by an absolute constant, the run's own measured seed-to-seed spread, and the empirically re-derived untouched-bank null's own spread -- both tails floored so no single source can be gamed to zero. GOV-REUSE-1: checked -- this is a genuinely new manipulation (BIAS write-selection under the 436e-family occupied-slots-only DV) never before recorded in any manifest; not recoverable from prior runs. Smoke PASS at seed=42: n_occupied=16/16 in both WAKING_ONLY and SWS_THEN_REM (BIAS occupancy floor confirmed live at smoke scale).
